title: Greek Painting, from Crete to Gaïtis
intro: Six centuries of Greek painters: the icon painters of Venetian Crete, their successors on the Ionian islands, the painters of the new Greek state who trained in Munich and Paris, and the modern painters of the twentieth century.

title: The Sea
intro: Harbours, storms, ships and shores, from the Dutch Golden Age to the twentieth century, hung across schools and countries.
